New Project.summary: Initial architecture workspace. Multi-tab workflows, role boundaries, and end-to-end business lifecycles.
invariants: Macroscopic big-picture view: omit trivial micro-interaction click steps.
Consolidate multiple related tabs into a single unified end-to-end lifecycle scenario.
Strict RBAC validation: isolate permissions across administrative and standard roles.
Cross-tab state persistence: ensure upstream modifications propagate without data loss.

boundaries.title: Authentication Limits
boundaries.rule: Impersonation tokens expire upon session close or navigation away from tenant portal.

boundaries.title: RBAC Boundaries
boundaries.rule: Standard users attempting administrative endpoints must trigger HTTP 403 Forbidden redirects.

boundaries.title: Data Persistence
boundaries.rule: Form drafts across multi-tab workflows must retain dirty-state flags until explicit submission or cancellation.
